lessons_used: Adding tips and a timer to waiting screens was helpful (+8.9%, p=0.0008), closely matching predictions (+8.0%).
Redesigning path choice screens (split view) and intro/welcome screen layouts (story scroll, split view redesign) was helpful.
Certain new flows and preview screens were harmful, such as a post-setup launcher flow (-19.6%) and customization style preview screen (-9.1%).
Copy changes, step reordering, hints, and other waiting screen changes showed no clear effect.
Predictions for path choice and layout redesign improvements were too low.
Predictions for new flows, new screens, step reordering, hints, and copy changes were consistently too high.

picked: Interactive Tip Carousel Waiting Screen Component

decisions.title: Interactive Tip Carousel Waiting Screen Component

lessons_next: Redesigning screens to split view layout, adding waiting screen tips and timer, using a story scroll layout, and sign-in persistence hints were helpful.
Certain new flows (post-setup launcher flow) and new screens (customization style preview screen) were harmful.
Copy changes, step reordering, and most other new screens, flows, and waiting screen variations showed no clear effect.
Predictions for winning layout redesigns, story scroll intro layout, and hints were too low.
Predictions for ineffective or harmful new flows, new screens, copy changes, and step reorders were consistently too high.
